windows.notes:
• New optional Approved for You row on kids' Home for AskFirst families
• Hold left or right to scrub with rising speed; tap to skip 10 seconds
• Preview pictures while seeking, on servers that have them
• Pick an avatar for each profile
• A profile's PIN is now needed to remove it or to change the lock
• Fixed black screen with sound when the next episode starts
• Coming back after being away asks who is watching, with PINs
